definition.en: Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) are government-owned scheduled commercial banks that operate at the regional level in different states of India to provide credit and other facilities to agriculture and rural sectors.
definition.hi: Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) are government-owned scheduled commercial banks that operate at the regional level in different states of India to provide credit and other facilities to agriculture and rural sectors.

importanceInUpsc.en: RRBs are critical for understanding financial inclusion and rural development in the Indian economy. UPSC frequently tests the ownership structure, regulatory framework, and their role in priority sector lending within the GS-3 syllabus.
importanceInUpsc.hi: RRBs are critical for understanding financial inclusion and rural development in the Indian economy. UPSC frequently tests the ownership structure, regulatory framework, and their role in priority sector lending within the GS-3 syllabus.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the institutional framework and ownership structure of RRBs.
learningOutcomes.hi: Understand the institutional framework and ownership structure of RRBs.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the role of RRBs in promoting financial inclusion in rural India.
learningOutcomes.hi: Analyze the role of RRBs in promoting financial inclusion in rural India.
